export-urn-li-share-6665263458038145024.caption:
I am pleased to share with you Issue 14 of the SIDS Bulletin, highlighting the leadership of SIDS in designing solutions for COVID-19 response and recovery, as well as commitments to climate action. 

https://lnkd.in/eGgWrPm

Despite the immense challenges that COVID-19 poses to SIDS, we continue to see strong action on accelerating sustainable development priorities aligned in the SAMOA Pathway. The AOSIS Placencia Ambition Forum reaffirmed that climate security lies at the heart of sustainability in SIDS, and that we must design our COVID-19 response to not only increase climate action and ambitions, but promote inclusive development. UNDP's Climate Promise seeks to strengthen this action, and is actively supporting 27 SIDS in developing their enhanced NDCs and in transforming their energy, transport and tourism sectors to reflect SIDS' climate stewardship and accelerate resilience building.

In this issue, we highlight various digital transformation and innovative financing mechanism that are vital our COVID-19 response and recovery efforts in SIDS, as well as success stories of SIDS operationalizing the three pillars of UNDP's Enhanced SIDS Offer.

Best regards and stay safe,
 Riad   

#UNDP4SIDS #RisingUpForSIDS #UNDPSIDSOffer
